name: Venera 7-class
tagline: First soft landing on another planet and first to transmit data from another planet's surface (Venus, 1970)
description: Venera 7-class is a planetary lander built by NPO Lavochkin in USSR. First soft landing on another planet and first to transmit data from another planet's surface (Venus, 1970). Retired after first flight in 1970.
best_known_for: First soft landing on another planet and first to transmit data from another planet's surface (Venus, 1970)
